lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Clusters of high-luminance circular spots are visible posterior to the gill slits, arranged in semi-regular vertical columns that transition into a more stochastic distribution toward the posterior-dorsal region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated intensity are visible intersecting with the circular blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern particularly evident in the mid-flank region posterior to the fifth gill slit.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature with a high-contrast vertical luminance gradient is visible running horizontally along the upper third of the lateral flank.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high spatial density of smaller, lower-intensity circular clusters compared to the primary lateral flank.
